latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Data Format Converter.

- Convert data files (CSV, JSON, XML, TXT) up to 200MB between formats.
- No software install required; runs via cloud GPU with 20–40 second processing.
- Supports exporting converted files as 1080p MP4 and other common formats.
- Simple onboarding: automatically acquires a token for new users, establishes session, and manages credits.
- Intuitive chat workflow with clear status updates and session management.
- Handles uploads, format conversion, video export, credits checking, and error handling for a smooth experience.
